Seer.actual_player_behavior: Nhan immediately announced that Cong is confirmed not a werewolf and stated they investigated him, effectively revealing their role as Seer.
Seer.verdict_notes: Nhan claimed the Seer role and shared results in the first round of debate.

Seer.directive_rationale: prioritize clearing the Guard and Witch to build a protected core
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Nhan investigated Cong, who was the Guard.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Seer investigated the Guard while both the Guard and Witch were alive.

Guard.directive_rationale: Your sole priority is to protect the Seer every single night. Never protect anyone else while the Seer is alive.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Cong protected Nhan (the Seer) in Round 1 night.
Guard.verdict_notes: Cong protected the Seer while the Seer was alive.

Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nam voted for Hoang but did not reveal their identity as the Witch during the debate.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nam remained stealthy and did not disclose the Witch role.

Witch.directive_rationale: Save potions are for protecting the Seer
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Nam used the SAVE potion on Nhan (the Seer) after the wolves targeted them.
Witch.verdict_notes: Nam used the save potion specifically to protect the Seer.

Witch.directive_rationale: Save potions are for... preserving a confirmed clear
Witch.verdict_notes: The save potion was already used in Round 1 to save the Seer; no other confirmed clear was attacked while a potion was available.

Villager.directive_rationale: Stop using 'vibe-based' language... Rely exclusively on the Seer's results.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin stated that Hoang's challenge of the Seer's claim was concerning and that they would observe Hoang's behavior.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin accepted the Seer's claim and focused on the person challenging it, though the language about 'observing behavior' is slightly vibe-based.

Villager.directive_rationale: When the Seer clears a player, that player is part of the Trusted Core
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin did not explicitly label Cong as 'Trusted Core', but accepted the Seer's clearance of Cong by focusing the suspicion on Hoang.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin acted in accordance with the clearance but did not use the specific terminology of a Trusted Core.

Villager.directive_rationale: any attempt to sow doubt within this core is a wolf signal
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin accused Hoang of being a Werewolf because Hoang challenged Nhan's Seer claim without evidence.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin identified the attempt to sow doubt regarding the Seer's claim and accused the player as a wolf.

Villager.directive_rationale: The moment a player... claims a deceased Seer's word 'carries no weight,' they have revealed themselves as a wolf.
Villager.verdict_notes: The game ended immediately after the night of Round 2 where the Seer died; there was no subsequent debate for this trigger to occur.

Villager.directive_rationale: The Trusted Core must immediately exile anyone attempting to invalidate the Seer's legacy.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Jin voted to exile Hoang, citing that Hoang's challenge of Nhan's Seer claim was a tactic to disrupt information gathering.
Villager.verdict_notes: Jin voted against the player who attempted to invalidate the Seer's claim.
